description: This Java class 'InstanceIdentifierSupplier' provides a mechanism to retrieve an instance identifier typically used in containerized environments. It determines the identifier based on environment variables such as 'INSTANCE_INDEX' or a hostname fallback, and implements the Supplier<String> interface to supply this value on demand.

classes.name: InstanceIdentifierSupplier
classes.description: A singleton class implementing Supplier<String> to provide a unique instance identifier based on environment variables or hostname.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of InstanceIdentifierSupplier, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Provides the instance identifier, caching the value after first retrieval.
